incident-bot: PagerDuty incident triggered: `autoscaler.queue_backlog_high` -> paging raj (on-call).

incident-bot: Summary: queue backlog > 100k for inference-api; avg queue latency 2.4s; 4.8% 5xx; autoscaler warnings. Grafana: https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/abcd

PagerDuty: Alert details -> https://pd.example/incidents/INC12345 :pager:

raj (on-call): acked. I'm looking. moving to #incident-room for live.

raj (on-call): quick check: HPA shows desired 20, current 20, min 2, max 20. node pool at max nodes. k8s events show FailedCreatePod: "No nodes available" and some image pull/backoff errors for new pods.

helen (sre): any sign of API throttles or cloud provider errors?

raj (on-call): cloud console shows ASG maxed out. Also seeing IAM rate-limit warnings for cloud autoscaler calls (some 403 from autoscaler controller). Could be hitting provider quotas.

monica (platform): I'll jump in. If autoscaler can't increase node group due to quota, manual override needed. Can we tolerate a quick increase of node-pool max to 80 and bump desired?

raj (on-call): customer impact: increased latency and some 502/504 for requests that hit the queue timeout. SLOs degraded. Triage: prioritize restoring capacity.

helen (sre): customers affected: streaming inference customers and a few large PLG tenants. I'll draft an incident note once we have mitigation.

monica (platform): running commands now to raise node pool limits and scale up nodes (GKE example). will share commands run.

monica (platform): ```bash
# increase node pool max (placeholder)
gcloud container node-pools update inference-pool --cluster=redwood-prod --region=us-central1 --enable-autoscaling --min-nodes=2 --max-nodes=80
# then manually increase current size if needed
gcloud container clusters resize redwood-prod --node-pool inference-pool --num-nodes=50 --region=us-central1 --quiet
```

incident-bot: PagerDuty update: escalation -> monica added to the incident.

raj (on-call): running quick checks: `kubectl get pods -n inference --field-selector=status.phase=Pending` shows ~3k Pending due to "pod has unbound immediate PersistentVolumeClaims" and scheduling. But majority waiting for nodes.

raj (on-call): also patching HPA to raise max replicas temporarily.

raj (on-call): ```bash
kubectl patch hpa inference-api -n inference -p '{"spec":{"maxReplicas":200}}'
# confirm
kubectl get hpa inference-api -n inference -o yaml | grep maxReplicas -A2
```

monica (platform): node pool update accepted by cloud provider. scaling to 50 nodes now. Giving scheduler a few mins. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

~5 minutes later~

raj (on-call): seeing pods start to move from Pending -> Running. queue length trending down: 124k -> 18k. latency improving.

helen (sre): monitoring traces in Tempo and APM. error rate down to 1.2%. still some spikey 5xx on a small shard.

raj (on-call): applied a targeted rollout rollback for a recent config that increased memory pressure on a small subset. That reduced OOM churn.

monica (platform): executing finish steps: updating ASG desired, verifying cloud quotas. Opening support ticket with provider for autoscaler API 403s.

monica (platform): provider ticket: https://cloudsupport.example/tickets/CS-7890

raj (on-call): passing active pager to helen for 1-hr observation. handoff: all manual overrides are in place, queues draining, primary mitigation = node pool scale + HPA max increase + targeted rollback.

helen (sre): ack. I'll monitor till stable. starting 01:20 UTC handoff.

helen (sre): immediate next steps (postmortem actions):
- validate autoscaler IAM permissions and increase quota limits
- add alert to catch autoscaler API 4xx/5xx calls before queue hits threshold
- runbook update: how to manually scale node-pool and patch HPA safely

raj (on-call): customers notified via status page draft: "Intermittent elevated latency and errors for inference API. Mitigation in progress; capacity increased." will update when we fully resolved.

monica (platform): cluster metrics back to normal baseline, queue < 2k now, error rate ~0.3%. will revert temporary HPA max once confident.

helen (sre): handing final ack to oncall rotation. Closing pager. :white_check_mark:

raj (on-call): thanks all. post-incident: follow-up meeting tomorrow 10:00 PT to go over autoscaler hardening and runbook. :calendar:

incident-bot: PagerDuty incident resolved (INC12345) - closed by helen.

helen (sre): summary for postmortem: root cause likely a combination of provider-side autoscaler quota/403 errors + conservative HPA max + a recent config causing memory pressure on a shard. Impact: elevated latency and some 502/504s for streaming customers for ~27 minutes. Mitigation: manual node-pool scale + HPA temporary max increase + targeted rollback. Next steps: runbook, quotas, alerting, provider support ticket.

monica (platform): adding runbook edits and PR referencing this incident. :rocket:
